Methods for smoothed curves

Source: R/spafun_fd-methods.R
spafun_fd-methods.Rd

Methods for the objects of class spafun_fd returned by funSmooth().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'spafun_fd'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spafun_fd'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, r_eval = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spafun_fd'
plot(x, y = NULL, groups = NULL, r_eval = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A spafun_fd object.

...

Not used.

row.names, optional

Not used (for compatibility with the generic).

r_eval

Grid on which the curves are evaluated. If NULL, the grid x$r.

y

Not used (for compatibility with the generic).

groups

Optional vector with one group per curve, named after the curves (as x$fd$fdnames$Sample) or in the same order.

Value

print() returns x invisibly; as.data.frame() a data.frame; plot() a ggplot object.

Details

  • print() summarises curves, basis, penalty and units.

  • as.data.frame() evaluates the curves on a grid and returns a long table with columns r, sample and value.

  • plot() draws the curves with ggplot2, optionally coloured by group.

Examples

set.seed(1)
r <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 50)
curves <- data.frame(r_value = r,
                     A = sin(2 * pi * r) + rnorm(50, sd = 0.1),
                     B = cos(2 * pi * r) + rnorm(50, sd = 0.1))
res <- funSmooth(curves, verbose = FALSE)
#> Warning: lambda reduced to 259.568955954505 to prevent overflow
#> Warning: lambda reduced to 259.568955954505 to prevent overflow
#> Warning: lambda reduced to 259.568955954505 to prevent overflow
print(res)
#> <spafun_fd> 2 curves
#>   r:          [0, 1] pixel, 50 points
#>   function:   Value
#>   centered:   no
#>   basis:      B-spline, order 6, 12 basis functions
#>   penalty:    derivative 4, lambda = 6e-08 (GCV, df = 6.29)
head(as.data.frame(res, r_eval = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)))
#>     r sample        value
#> 1 0.0      A -0.065702608
#> 2 0.1      A  0.632051883
#> 3 0.2      A  0.983101048
#> 4 0.3      A  0.960396503
#> 5 0.4      A  0.589219632
#> 6 0.5      A -0.001325807
plot(res, groups = c(A = "sin", B = "cos"))
